result.topic_en: Prose notes saying that the changes of the boundary values are only restricted from being discontinuous along part of the boundary, and defining the simplicity of a dependence law by the number of quantity operations needed to express it.
result.transcription:

nur der Beschränkung unterworfen, nicht
